sn22.35:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
sn22.35:1.3: ‘‘sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu;
sn22.35:1.4: yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho, appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyya’’nti.
sn22.35:1.5: ‘‘Yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, anuseti, tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
sn22.35:1.6: yaṃ nānuseti, na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatī’’ti.
sn22.35:2.1: ‘‘Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī’’ti?
sn22.35:2.2: ‘‘Rūpaṃ ce, bhante, anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.3: Vedanaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.4: Saññaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.5: Saṅkhāre ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.6: Viññāṇaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.7: Rūpaṃ ce, bhante, nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.11: viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.12: Imassa khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī’’ti.
sn22.35:3.2: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.35:3.3: Rūpaṃ ce, bhikkhu, anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.7: viññāṇaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.8: Rūpaṃ ce, bhikkhu, nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.12: viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.13: Imassa kho, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena, bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo’’ti.
sn22.35:4.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn22.35:5.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn22.35:5.2: ‘‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’’ti abbhaññāsi.
sn22.35:5.3: Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
